what: Abbott makes medical devices (including the FreeStyle Libre glucose monitor), diagnostic tests, nutrition products such as Similac and Ensure, and branded generic medicines for emerging markets.
customers: Hospitals, laboratories, doctors, pharmacies and consumers.
moat: Four diversified businesses, leading brands and decades of rising dividends.
opportunities: Its continuous glucose monitors are growing at double digits in a market still far from saturated
Four different businesses mean a weak year in one rarely sinks the whole company

watch: Diabetes care revenue growth and organic growth excluding COVID testing.
